Name: kragon's talkohlooeys-style RSV Bachelorette Portraits
Author: kragonaught
Description:
**Now available for Content Patcher and Portraiture**

Includes all portraits from RSV 2.0 update.

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78766618]talkohlooeys[/url] for allowing me to recreate their awesome art style, I hope I was able to do it justice :')

With talkohlooeys' [url=https://talkohstardew.blogspot.com/]announcement[/url] that the Seasonal Outfit update will be the end of their portrait series, I really wanted to keep the art style alive in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Valley[/url]﻿! (at least just for the romanceable ladies at the moment) I'm open to doing the bachelors' portraits as well if there's enough request for it.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9352]OrangePie's RSV portrait mod[/url] was also a big inspiration for me, so thank you too :)
